about.tagline: Download posts, attachments and whole creators from Pawchive, right in your browser.
about.step1: Open a post or a creator page on pawchive.pw.
about.step2: Click the paw button in the corner, or press Alt+Shift+D.
about.step3: Pick files or posts, choose separate files or a ZIP archive, and press Download.
about.step4: Follow progress here or in the toolbar popup. Downloads continue in the background.
about.featurePanel: Download panel on every post and creator page
about.featureCreators: Whole creators, filtered by date, title and file type
about.featureZip: ZIP archives built in the browser, split when large
about.featureRelay: Full files for preview-only posts through temporary links
about.featureTemplates: Folder and file name templates with a live preview
about.featureWatch: Watchlist that finds new posts and can download them
about.featureHistory: History that skips what you already have
about.politeBody: At most five downloads at once and one new request per second, as Pawchive asks. When the site says to slow down, every request waits until it is ready again.
about.ethicsBody: Creators rely on their supporters. Download only what you have the right to, keep it for personal use, and support the creators you enjoy on their own pages.
about.privacyBody: No accounts, tracking or analytics. Settings, history and logs stay in your browser; the extension only talks to pawchive.pw.

support.title: Enjoying Pawchive Downloader?
support.body: It is free and open source, and it will stay that way. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi. It keeps the updates coming.
